how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; engines provide thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.

demo.program:
# JAH Databases demo — record JAH-CRJ-000017
# Bombardier CRJ Series: Blueprint: cross-section
model = "Bombardier CRJ Series"
mtow_kg = 38330
wing_area_m2 = 70.6
derived = mtow_kg / wing_area_m2
print(f"Derived wing loading: {derived:,.1f} kg/m²")  # -> 542.9 kg/m²
print("specs: Length: 36.4 m (CRJ900); Wingspan: 24.85 m; Height: 7.5 m; Maximum takeoff weight: 38,330 kg; Engines: 2 × General Electric CF34; Typical seating: 76–90; Range: 2,870 km (CRJ900); Cruise: Mach 0.78")
print("OK: JAH-CRJ-000017 verified")
demo.note: Demonstration recomputes the derived statistic from the record's own numbers.
